<function=python>

def blacks(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='B' and 20<n['pixels']<100:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols),n['pixels']))
    return sorted(out)
action(['RIGHT']*2)
print("B2 now:", blacks(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
